introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content:
This Privacy Policy describes how our Port Management System ("the System", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, processes, and protects personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.

By using our System, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

dataCollection.title: 4. How We Collect Personal Data
methods: Direct Input: Port Authority Officers register shipping agents, representatives, and staff members through system forms
User Submission: Shipping Agent Representatives submit vessel visit notifications containing crew information
Authentication Provider: Auth0 provides user identity information upon login
Automatic Collection: System generates audit logs automatically during user interactions
Activation Process: Users provide confirmation through activation links sent to their email

purposes: Managing vessel visit notifications and approvals
Ensuring properly certified personnel operate equipment
Safety requirements for dangerous cargo handling

legalBasis.title: 6. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content:
We process personal data based on the following legal grounds under GDPR Article 6(1):

| Data Type | Legal Basis | Description |
|-----------|------------|-------------|
| Shipping Agent Data | Contractual Necessity (b) | Required to provide port services and manage vessel visits |
| Staff Operational Data | Contractual Necessity (b) & Legitimate Interests (f) | Necessary for efficient port operations and safety |
| Crew Information | Legal Obligation (c) | Required by maritime law and safety regulations |
| Authentication Data | Contractual Necessity (b) | Required to provide secure access to the system |
| Audit Logs | Legal Obligation (c) & Legitimate Interests (f) | Required for security, compliance, and fraud prevention |
| Dangerous Cargo Safety Officers | Legal Obligation (c) | Required by regulations governing hazardous materials |

dataRetention.title: 7. Data Retention
dataRetention.content:
| Data Category            | Retention Period                      | Justification                             |
|--------------------------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Shipping Agent Records   | 7 years after last activity           | Maritime compliance requirements          |
| Staff Records            | 5 years after employment/contract end | Labor law and audit requirements          |
| Vessel Visit Data        | 7 years                               | Maritime and customs regulations          |
| Audit Logs               | 3 years                               | Security and compliance requirements      |
| User Authentication Data | Duration of account + 1 year          | Access control and security investigation |
| Inactive Accounts        | Deleted after 2 years of inactivity   | Data minimization principle               |

After retention periods expire, personal data is either securely deleted or anonymized.

recipients.purpose: Access to all operational data necessary for port management
Access limited to their own organization's data and vessel visit notifications
Access to operational planning data, staff schedules, and resource allocations
Technical access for system maintenance and support
When required by court order or legal obligation

dataSubjectRights.title: 9. Data Subject Rights
rights: Right to Erasure / 'Right to be Forgotten' (Article 17)

security.title: 10. Security Measures
measures: Encryption: Data encrypted in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest
Access Controls: Role-based access control (RBAC) and attribute-based access control (ABAC)
Authentication: Secure authentication via Auth0 with multi-factor authentication support
Audit Logging: Comprehensive logging of all data access and modifications
Network Security: Access restricted to DEI internal network or VPN (development/staging environments)
Regular Security Assessments: Periodic security audits and vulnerability testing
Data Backup: Regular encrypted backups with defined Recovery Point Objectives (RPO)
Incident Response: Documented procedures for data breach notification

internationalTransfers.title: 11. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Authentication services are provided by Auth0, which may process data in countries outside the EEA. Auth0 complies with applicable data transfer mechanisms including EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).

cookies.title: 12. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: Our system uses cookies and similar technologies. See our separate Cookie Policy for details.

dataBreach.title: 13. Data Breach Notification
dataBreach.content: In the event of a personal data breach that poses a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority within 72 hours and notify affected individuals without undue delay.

childrenPrivacy.title: 14. Children's Privacy
childrenPrivacy.content: Our system is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

changes.title: 15. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be communicated via email to registered users, prominent notice on login page, and updating the 'Effective Date'.
